categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies error handling in ConnectBlock and ActivateBestChainStep within src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents inconsistent hybrid validation state and duplicate fatal error notifications during block connection and tip disconnection failures. The underlying issue produces confusing error reporting when handling mutated blocks or disk flush failures, and resolving it cleans up in-out parameter handling to unblock #35570, but it does not alter consensus rules or introduce safety hazards.
